title: Scholarships
description: Major active central government scholarship schemes plus Telangana and Andhra Pradesh state scholarship schemes.
scope_note: Scheme names reflect current official branding; several Andhra Pradesh schemes were renamed in a June 2024 government transition, cross-referenced in notes.
